status: frozen before conversion or model inference
purpose: One native M2M100 418M float32 feasibility/development screen for English/Greek translation, without production integration.
hypothesis: A dedicated multilingual encoder-decoder with source/target language tokens may preserve ordinary media terms, quantities, actors and dates better than the rejected chat packages. Quality is unknown until independently reviewed.

repository_state.note: This isolated experiment is added to a working tree with unrelated parent-owned integration changes. Exact executed helper/source hashes, rather than a clean-checkout claim, bind the run.

model.license_evidence: Pinned official model card plus retained originating Fairseq MIT license text.

conversion.identity_rule: Record full SHA256/size of every converted file and every source tokenization before a separate final inference freeze.

protocol.tokenizer: AutoTokenizer standard M2M100 class, use_fast=False, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False
protocol.source_text: Entire original segment text, unchanged; no glossary, rewriting, sentence splitting, normalization by the runner, or extra instructions. The standard tokenizer performs its native normalization.
protocol.source_bound_action: Reject any source exceeding the bound; never truncate. Require source-language prefix, EOS suffix and no unknown source token.
protocol.target_prefix: Exactly one native language token: tokenizer.lang_code_to_token[target_language]. No other prefix.
protocol.completion_rule: Require one finite-scored hypothesis per original segment, the exact target-language prefix, returned terminal EOS, nonempty content, raw length strictly below 512, and no special content tokens. Preserve raw tokens before rejecting.
protocol.decoding: Strip only the expected language prefix and terminal EOS; standard tokenizer decode with skip_special_tokens=False and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False; trim outer whitespace only.
protocol.model_lifecycle: One resident native translator, sequential six-case screen, explicit unload at end and owned worker process exit.

evaluation.source_origin: The exact exposed development-only copy used in the prior Qwen screen, copied byte for byte.
evaluation.per_segment_behavior: One native translation attempt for each complete original source segment, using the model native batching API and original order. No retries or candidate selection.
evaluation.semantic_review: Independent review against every original case criterion. Lexical flags, fluent text and execution success do not approve meaning.

limits.memory_scope: Concurrent monitor and owned worker process tree; RSS upper bound with PSS also recorded. Stop owned process group when sampled RSS exceeds 6144 MiB. This is interval enforcement, not a kernel hard cap.
limits.preparation_limits: Each dependency install subprocess <=600 seconds. Each source file download <=600 seconds and declared byte count; total source fetch <=900 seconds.

stop_rules: Stop on conversion failure, source/version mismatch, incomplete memory evidence, process-budget excess, deadline, source-token loss, malformed native output, missing EOS or output reaching its limit.
Stop the screen at its first execution/completion failure; preserve the partial report and raw tokens.
A major independently reviewed meaning error blocks promotion, summary testing and heldout progression; finish only the already authorized fixed development screen unless the parent stops it.
Do not change model, precision, language tokens, beam width, segmentation, source text, output budget or criteria after an output is seen.
controls: The isolated virtual environment and source/converted weights live outside the repository; core dependencies/environment and production code are unchanged.
No trust_remote_code, prompt, answer/reference, glossary, forced word replacement, opaque community quantization, model retry or output rewrite.
Read and submit only the six exposed cases; references and review criteria stay outside model arguments.
Conversion and inference run in separate owned processes with separately retained memory, time and OOM observations.
Small pre-inference monitor controls verified normal completion, forced deadline stop and forced memory stop; these are infrastructure controls, not model-quality evidence.
Raw source text, token IDs/tokens, language prefixes, native options, hypotheses, EOS and scores remain available for review.
Independent reviewer receives completed outputs immediately and freezes judgments separately from the model runner.

primary_sources.supports: Dedicated multilingual translation model, Greek/English language codes, MIT model-card license and target-language control.
Native M2M100 conversion and target_prefix protocol.
CPU threads, beam search, disabling input truncation, output caps and returned EOS.
Explicit conversion precision, memory-loading option and trust_remote_code control.

decision_scope: A small, previously exposed development screen. It cannot approve arbitrary transcript translation, production integration, document-length fidelity, summaries, heldouts or v1.0.
